stories.headline: Instacart reportedly discussed selling itself with DoorDash and Uber
stories.summary: Grocery delivery platform Instacart has reportedly hired an investment bank to evaluate potential sale options, engaging in acquisition discussions with major competitors DoorDash and Uber. While talks with Uber reportedly broke down, the discussions indicate possible consolidation within the delivery sector. Instacart holds a market valuation exceeding $13 billion following a 25% increase in its stock price year-to-date.

stories.headline: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.summary: A growing list of AI startups and internal corporate projects are shutting down or failing to meet expectations as competition from major tech companies intensifies. Notable recent failures include Relay, an AI workflow automation tool that closed in August after larger platforms integrated similar features, and chatbot platform Character.ai, which filed for bankruptcy five years after its launch.

stories.headline: These clever apps show off the iPhone Duo’s potential
stories.summary: Developers are creating creative applications designed to leverage the dual-screen capabilities of Apple's new foldable device, the iPhone Duo. These early software concepts include retro cassette players, virtual notebooks, and flight trackers that demonstrate new user interface possibilities for the foldable form factor.

stories.headline: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
stories.summary: A study by research firm Convovo found significant political bias differences between major language models when forced to recommend candidates for US election races. xAI's Grok model favored Republican candidates in 92% of responses, while OpenAI's GPT model recommended Democrats in 97% of cases, with the two models agreeing less than 10% of the time across nearly 500 races.

stories.headline: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
stories.summary: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro has signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law. The legislation mandates clear disclosures on any advertisement—including text, audio, images, or video—that has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: PHP-ocalypse: How two critical web bugs almost broke the internet
stories.summary: Two critical vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language, dubbed PHP2Shell, were recently disclosed, allowing unauthenticated attackers to breach online systems running PHP. Designated as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the decades-old flaws threaten millions of websites and servers worldwide that rely on the open-source web technology.

stories.headline: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
stories.summary: A newly discovered vulnerability in the open-source programming language PHP recently prompted urgent warnings for website owners to patch or temporarily shut down affected sites. The incident highlights critical security risks in core web infrastructure, raising concerns about how future AI tools could further expose existing vulnerabilities in open-source software.

stories.headline: Flipkart’s Summer Of Discontent
stories.summary: Flipkart is facing increased pressure to achieve profitability while navigating questions surrounding its initial public offering and employee stock option plans. The Indian e-commerce major is simultaneously committing substantial investments into quick commerce and food delivery to maintain its competitive edge.

stories.headline: Starlink seems to be working normally again in Ukraine
stories.summary: SpaceX appears to have restored full functionality to Starshield, the military-grade version of its Starlink satellite internet system used by Ukraine. Defense officials reported that the service is operating normally again following a 10-day period where Ukrainian military drones repeatedly lost connectivity at high speeds.
